subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, which state has the second highest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has the **second highest sex ratio** according to the **Census of India 2011**.
 
• The sex ratio is an important demographic indicator that reflects the **number of females per 1000 males** in a population.
 
• **Kerala **holds the **highest sex ratio** among the Indian states, followed by Tamil Nadu.
 
• Improving the sex ratio is a critical aspect of achieving gender equality and addressing issues related to gender imbalances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India** is conducted every ten years and is the most comprehensive source of demographic data in the country.
 
• The **2011 Census** was the **15th National Census since 1871** and provided detailed data on population distribution, sex ratio, literacy rates, and other key metrics.
 
• Efforts to improve the sex ratio include initiatives like **Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao** (Save the Daughter, Educate the Daughter) which aims to address the declining child sex ratio and promote gender equality.
 
• Continuous monitoring and targeted policies are essential to address the factors contributing to the skewed sex ratio, such as gender-based discrimination and preferences for male children.
